item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:30 HKT 22/Jun/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring generally fine and very hot weather to the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days. The anticyclone aloft is expected to weaken slightly early next week, there will be a few showers over the coast of Guangdong.

Date/Month: 22/06 (Wednesday)
Wind: South force 3.
Weather: Mainly fine. Very hot during the day.
Temp range: 28 - 33 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
